framework_fidelity.source: deterministic legality plus source-hidden Luna-high framework score

cbt_progress.source: frozen CBT Evidence Tracker plus deterministic monotonic official-step executor

empathy.requires: specific proportionate non-assumptive support grounded in visible patient language

naturalness.source: 0.70 Luna-high dialogue naturalness plus 0.30 frozen counsellor-SFT response alignment
naturalness.guidance: believable counsellor speech, ordinary wording, one manageable focus, natural turn-taking

resistance_transition.source: temperature-calibrated state-aware expected utility under the frozen selected Resistance State Tracker, with positive credit gated by concurrent framework-fidelity and empathy judgments
resistance_transition.raw_expected_utility: sum_d calibrated_probability(d | state, visible_history, candidate) * state_utility[state][d] over graph-legal directions

triggers: unsafe or contract-breaking Luna hard failure

dynamic_weights.reason: allow gradual compensation for lagging objectives without rapid naturalness-weight collapse
